auth_details: No authentication required. Public endpoints are open; no API key or signup needed.
free_tier_limits: Unlimited free use; no published request caps on the free public service
description: Frankfurter is a free, open-source currency exchange rates API that aggregates daily foreign exchange data from multiple central banks. It provides current and historical rates for major currencies without authentication. Developers can convert amounts, fetch latest rates, and query time-series data for finance apps, pricing tools, and multi-currency ecommerce workflows.
